description: This file defines vectorized mask load and cast operations for CPU vector instruction sets, specifically for AVX2, including template specializations for different data types and vector sizes.

classes.name: VecMaskLoad
classes.description: Template struct for loading vector masks with specializations based on data type and vector size.

classes.name: VecMaskCast
classes.description: Template struct for casting between different vector mask types and sizes.

classes.name: VecMaskCheck
classes.description: Template struct for checking properties of vector masks, such as all zero or all masked.

methods.description: Performs vectorized mask load operations for different data types and vector sizes.
